يكتشفون (form VIII)
# يَكْتَشِفُونَ (yaktašifūna) /jak.ta.ʃi.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# يُكْتَشَفُونَ (yuktašafūna) /juk.ta.ʃa.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
